Watch. Attack. Witness. Close.

Most tools only watch.
Aegis does all four.

Every finding becomes precise work: where it is, why it happens, what it can cost, who can fix it and the check that will prove closure.

Sentinel · Watch

Tests production and staging on the agreed schedule and detects what is broken or drifting.

Crucible · Attack

Applies deliberate adversarial pressure across access, data, scale, integrations, logic and commercial rules.

Witness · See

Captures what real users encounter, including errors, dead ends and failed journeys.

Warden · Close

Keeps every finding open until the originating check runs again and comes back clean.

The Inspector Panel

Test the platform.
Test the business.

The Adversary tests security. The Auditor tests billing and commercial health. The Engineer tests the codebase. The Operator tests business logic. The Newcomer tests first use. The Customer tests the complete journey.

Aegis never changes a client system without explicit authorisation. Authorised repair is enabled per deployment, followed by the same repeat check before closure.

Frequently asked

Questions buyers ask.

If your question is not here, ask it directly and we will answer it against what the system does today.

What is Varren Aegis?

Varren Aegis watches, attacks and witnesses a digital platform, then holds every finding open until the check that found it passes again. It can examine security, performance, integrations, user experience, business logic, billing and releases.

Who is Varren Aegis for?

Teams responsible for live websites, platforms and digital services.

What problem does Varren Aegis solve?

A platform can look healthy while a security boundary, payment, journey, integration or pricing rule is already failing.

How does Varren Aegis work?

Sentinel watches. Crucible attacks. Witness sees what real users hit. Warden keeps the finding open until a repeat check proves the fix.

What changes once Varren Aegis is running?

Teams see the verdict, the exact finding, its cause, priority, responsible role, recommended fix and verified closure.

How is success measured?

Time to find; time to verified fix; repeat checks passing; customer-visible issues prevented; commercial leaks found.

Can Varren Aegis be deployed for a single organisation?

Yes. AlphaIT licenses, deploys, configures and integrates the system for each organisation, and engineers the missing connection or capability where the ready system does not fully fit. Scope, integrations, data permissions, acceptance checks, support and commercial terms are agreed per deployment.

Which countries can Varren Aegis be deployed in?

AlphaIT Engineering works with organisations in Kenya, Nigeria, the United Arab Emirates and the wider Middle East. Deployment is subject to applicable law, the data permissions available and the authority of each participating organisation.
